effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If your opponent has a Digimon, gain 1 memory.
[On Play] 1 of your [Marcus Damon]s may suspend.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Tamer suspends, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.) and +3000 DP for the turn. Then, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn.
